startWorkflowDescription: Gets the first step of the Grievers Guidance list for someone who has lost a loved one. This tool never sends messages. It takes no names, no contacts and no free text.
nextStepTitle: Get the next Grievers Guidance step
nextStepDescription: Gets the next step on the list, once the person says the last one is done. This tool never sends messages. It takes no names, no contacts and no free text.
agentInstruction: Give the person the step text exactly as written. Do not reword it. Show one step at a time, and wait until they say it is done before you ask for the next.
handOff: Text them yourself, from your own phone, one person at a time.
whatDoneMeans: This step is done when you have finished it and are ready to go on.
allDone: There are no more steps right now. You can come back to this list whenever you like.
